title: Yarim-Lim I
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-16 Table 1 (Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC)).
description: Ruler of Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 1, "Chronology of Neighboring Kings to Israel in the 11th Century"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: ~1045; End: ~1004). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 1 "Chronology of Neighboring Kings to Israel in the 11th Century", p. 5
reign.note: Row "Yarim-Lim I (Hamath-Yamhad)" of Table 1 (Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC)).
